name: Baaz Records
tagline: Punjabi music, recorded live and pressed on vinyl
description: Baaz Records is an independent Punjabi music label. Folk, sufi and late-night dub, recorded live and pressed on vinyl in small, hand-stamped runs.

contact.note: Demos, bookings, press and wholesale. We reply within two working days.

demo.intro: Recorded on a phone or in a studio, we listen to everything that comes in. Send a link to your music and tell us a little about yourself.
